body:
## What it does

Each lesson is small on purpose: a single familiar image that makes the idea click, then a quick question to confirm it landed before anything else is added. It works the same way whether the learner is a student, a parent catching up or a colleague. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @anandVragav shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
